recommendations.title: Sea-Blue Under-utilized
recommendations.description: Sea-blue should be the secondary CTA color, but is used sparingly.
recommendations.action: Add sea-blue to secondary CTAs, hover states on secondary actions
recommendations.example: Secondary "Learn More" links, checkbox focus states

recommendations.title: Deep-Gray Mostly Unused
recommendations.description: Deep-gray is defined but rarely used. Consider if it serves a purpose.
recommendations.action: Either use deep-gray for info/grounded states or remove from palette
recommendations.example: Info boxes, secondary borders, grounded text for men/ADHD personas

recommendations.title: Sage Over-used
recommendations.description: Sage (burgundy) is dominant across many contexts, diluting impact.
recommendations.action: Reduce sage to primary CTAs and key highlights only. Move form inputs to warm-gray.
recommendations.example: Form labels, error text, info boxes can use warm-gray instead

recommendations.title: Readability Issues Found
recommendations.description: 139 instances of accent colors in non-ideal contexts.
recommendations.action: Review and move to neutral alternatives

recommendations.title: Establish Clear Accent Hierarchy
recommendations.description: Define when each accent is used to prevent confusion.
recommendations.action: Document: sage=primary CTA, clay=secondary CTA, sea-blue=tertiary CTA/hover
recommendations.example: Primary: "Book Now" | Secondary: "Learn More" | Tertiary: icon hover

recommendations.title: Accent Color Consistency Audit
recommendations.description: 35 files contain accent colors. Verify consistent application.
recommendations.action: Run visual QA on key pages (booking, about, specialty pages)
recommendations.example: Ensure all primary CTAs are the same color; all hover states consistent
